summary: Flagstar Bank filed an 8-K announcing a $250 million common stock repurchase program authorized by its Board, valid for 12 months via open-market or private transactions, possibly under Rule 10b5-1 plans. Terms: up to $250M over the next year, no set price or number of shares specified. The program may be modified or suspended at any time. Mechanics: open-market or negotiated purchases, subject to capital position, regulatory constraints, and market conditions. This is a capital return event—a buyback authorization—with no stated premium, advisor, or regulatory clock. Watch for actual repurchase cadence and whether it signals management's view of undervaluation.
